notes: 2025 standard deduction, v3 successor to v2 (Track 2, Contract item 3; repair round 1). When someone can claim the taxpayer, or the spouse on a joint return, as a dependent, publishes the Standard Deduction Worksheet for Dependents' line 4c. Otherwise publishes worksheet line 3 + line 4b -- not a copy of v2's own expression tree. This equals v2's computation exactly, for every filing status, because line 3 reuses the same tax.us.2025.parameter.standard-deduction-base lookup v2 used for its base amount, and line 4b is line 1's box count (now gated on filing_status exactly as v2 gates its own spouse_over_65/spouse_blind additions, repair round 1) times the same tax.us.2025.parameter.additional-standard-deduction lookup v2 used for each of its four conditional additions -- summing one indicator per box and multiplying once by the shared per-box rate is the same total as adding that rate once per true box, for every filing status, with no case-by-case difference to reconcile. v2 is retired from package membership (replaced, not edited; presentation_projection's one-row-per-symbol join forbids two producers of demo.form1040.standard_deduction at once, per rule.form1040-line12e's own notes on tax.us.2025.deductions.line-12e). The dependent answer is a mandatory pin (requires/pins, no optional_default): a return that adopts this package without answering it blocks DEPENDENCY_ABSENT naming the fact, never silently taking the non-dependent branch.

said: Filing status, whether the taxpayer or spouse is 65 or older or blind, and whether someone can claim the taxpayer or spouse as a dependent, are the return's own facts.
derived: When someone can claim the taxpayer or spouse as a dependent, the standard deduction is the Standard Deduction Worksheet for Dependents' line 4c.

Otherwise, the standard deduction is the worksheet's own line 3 (the 2025 base amount for the filing status) plus line 4b (the age/blindness addition), which equals the base amount plus each applicable age-65 or blindness box's 2025 additional amount for that filing status.
assumed: This line does not compute the senior deduction.
left_with_person: The senior deduction on Schedule 1-A, for a person aged 65 or older, is not computed here.
